name: Anterior Ankle Impingement
definition: Painful anterior ankle compression during dorsiflexion caused by osteophytes, synovitis, scar tissue or repetitive athletic loading.

investigations.principle: Radiographs demonstrate anterior osteophytes; MRI/CT is selected for cartilage/soft-tissue or surgical planning.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent mechanical impingement may require arthroscopic debridement.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha-Sandhi mechanical phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Painful anterior ankle compression during dorsiflexion caused by osteophytes, synovitis, scar tissue or repetitive athletic loading.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
